answer: Reputation here is earned through attestation edges that must span real graph distance: an agent's identity counts only when vouched by peers at least three hops away, so a sybil cluster of mutually-linked fakes stays isolated and worthless, like timber grown in a hothouse that never touches the vine. Each valid edge requires the attester to post an onyx bond slashed if the vouched identity later misbehaves, forcing attackers to burn honest capital across genuinely independent nodes, not just spin up cheap clones.
